summary: BATCH A — Financial-safety race-condition tests. ALL 5/5 PASS. Verified atomic publish lock + atomic credit deduction, bulk-publish credit charging, Razorpay verify-payment signature-race safety, gift-code redemption uniqueness (DuplicateKeyError on (code, admin_id) compound unique index), and bulk-purge refund flow. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_batch_a_race_safety.py. JUnit XML: /app/test_reports/pytest/batch_a_results.xml.

results_per_test.TEST 1 — Double-Click Publish: PASS — codes=[200,400], used_credits=3 (expected 3), ledger USED entries=1 (expected 1), _publish_lock cleared, status=published
results_per_test.TEST 2 — Bulk-Publish Backdoor: PASS — matched=3 modified=3 success=3 failed=0, used_credits=9 (expected 9), ledger USED entries=3 (expected 3). The backdoor is closed: bulk-publish now charges credits identically to single publish via wedding_lifecycle_service.publish_wedding loop
results_per_test.TEST 3 — Razorpay Verify-Payment Race: PASS — both parallel requests with forged signature returned 400 'Invalid payment signature'. payment_record.status stayed 'created' (no credit added). Real Razorpay create-order skipped because db.credit_packages is empty; used direct payment_records insert per task spec alternative path
results_per_test.TEST 4 — Gift Code Redemption Race: PASS — codes=[200,400], exactly 1 gift_code_redemptions row, 1 ADD ledger entry, total_credits=200 (expected 200, NOT 300). Confirms unique compound index (code, admin_id) atomically blocks concurrent duplicate redemption.
results_per_test.TEST 5 — Bulk-Purge Refund: PASS — refunded_count=1, refunded_total=3 (==publish cost), profile hard-deleted (find_one returns None), REFUND ledger entry present, available_credits=100 restored

minor.issue: S3 cleanup during bulk purge logs 's3_cleanup_failed:1' (AWS not configured in test env). Not a functional bug — best-effort cleanup is wrapped in try/except, refund still succeeds.
db.credit_packages collection is empty in this env → real Razorpay order flow can't be tested end-to-end. Tested verify-payment race via direct payment_records insert (per task spec alternative).

critical_code_review_comments: wedding_lifecycle_service.publish_wedding() — sound two-tier race protection: (1) find_one_and_update sets _publish_lock atomically gated by status not-in published/archived, (2) admins find_one_and_update with used_credits<=total_credits-total_cost guard. Try/except releases lock on failure. Verified safe under parallel POSTs.

admin_dashboard_v2.bulk_action(publish) — routes each ID through publish_wedding so the per-row atomic deduction applies; correct fix for the 'free bulk publish' backdoor. Failures don't roll back successes — appropriate.

gift_code_routes.redeem_code — reserve-first pattern correctly leverages unique index on (code, admin_id). On a credit-add failure after reservation, the row stays as evidence (documented). Acceptable.

razorpay_credit_service.verify_payment — find_one_and_update flips status created→paid atomically; concurrent callers get 'already processed (concurrent)'. Signature validation happens BEFORE the atomic flip, so bad-sig requests never touch the record.
Note: db.credit_ledger collection is singular, while task description used 'credit_ledgers'. Tests updated accordingly.
Note: VerifyPaymentRequest model requires package_id field — initial assumption from task spec missed this. Documented in test.
MINOR: bulk_action(purge) S3 deletion runs synchronously inside the request handler — for large purges could block. Consider background task. Not a financial-safety issue.
action_items: No fixes needed. All 5 race-safety guarantees verified under concurrent stress (asyncio.gather two parallel POSTs).
Optional: seed db.credit_packages with at least one active row to enable full Razorpay create-order flow testing in this env.
test_credentials: Used testphoto@test.com / TestPass123! per /app/memory/test_credentials.md; super-admin only used for verifying no double-charge would be possible (not tested directly — bypasses cost).
seed_data_creation: Per-test: seeded publishable profiles directly into db.profiles with all check_ready_status fields populated. Gift code inserted directly into db.gift_codes with per_account_limit=1. Cleaned up after each run; wallet reset to total=100/used=0 between tests and at end.

Ledger collection is db.credit_ledger (singular). action_type values are lowercase: 'used', 'add', 'refund'. /api/payments/verify-payment lives in razorpay_credit_service.py (new endpoint) and requires package_id in body. /api/payments/verify is the OLD endpoint in server.py:10708. Two routes coexist.
